text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during a break in my training
session
with <chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Righty-o, time for another day of giv'n
my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is positively brimming with
vigor as
usual, I see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned seeing a friend run
earlier. It
seems to have lit a fire under
her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Motivation comes from all sorts of
people,
doesn't it? Whether it be peers,
rivals, or people
we admire...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Put another way, it's essential to have
someone
like that if we're to keep
running toward our
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone racing with all their
heart ignites
something in us, and makes
us want to do better.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I agree. When I watch Spe run, I
feel the
same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, then. Shall we begin our training
as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We ought to step up our game too, lest
we get
left behind by Special Week or
all the other
racers working towards
their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume here all have dreams.
Watching
them running towards those
lofty goals pushes us
forward and imbues
every race with passion.
